notes.title: New levels
notes.content:
Ok soooo we got like cave world and the bank world is now a Robot factory with conveyor belts and boxes and stuff. 
Also Celex does flips when jumping off of walls now

notes.title: New world (Ancient Temple)
notes.content:
Ok soooo I made new levels and half 5 levels for the new Ancient Temple level
Here's some more new stuff

- New Castle level Background
- World 2 is now a bank vault level
- New pause menu and main menu music (the old music was just Shante music)
- Celex does a roll when hitting the ground hard while running fast
- Celex does a flip when flinging himself off the celling
- New boss fight intro cutscene (Working on making it better quality in game and having it not cut off)
- Dying from Reswob now doesn't crash the game
- Credits in the main menu for the other people who've worked on the game
- Level 1X, 9X and 10X (Hard optional levels)
- Other small level changes and bug fixes

kk I got stuff to work on byyyye :)

notes.title: Pixel Panic artwork/bug fixes Update
notes.content:
Whasup people :D I updated the game to give the game better cutscenes. I also hired an artist to do some artwork for said cutscenes.

 I also made a bunch of other bug fixes and changes such as
- Fixed the pause menu being weird
- Overworld textboxes now readable
- Bombs prolly don't crashing the game anymore
- Gave a formal demo ending at level 25
- Epic boss fight intro
- Oh god I just realized I didn't patch level 20 aaaaaaaaaaaaaa plz don't mess around in there

OK y'all just don't select level 12 in free play mode or that crashes the game
bye now :3
